create_mcp_servers: create MCP server connections and register their tools into the hermes-agent tool registry
discover_mcp_tools: discover MCP tools by loading config, connecting to servers, and registering tools
get_mcp_status: get status of all configured MCP servers including connection state and tool counts
run_mcp_probe: run a temporary probe of MCP server tools without registering them in the registry
shutdown_mcp_servers: shutdown all MCP server connections and stop the background event loop
review_SamplingHandler: review the SamplingHandler class that manages server-initiated LLM sampling requests
review_MCPServerTask: review the MCPServerTask class that manages a single MCP server connection lifecycle
